text: So sorry to bother you, I'm a childminder and I've got a little girl 21 months staying late as her mum is stuck. Her breathing is really fast, I can see her tummy sucking in under her ribs and she's making a little grunting noise with each breath, and a couple of times I think it stoped for a second before she started again. Her colour looks normal, lips are pink, skin same as usual. She also has a blotchy rash on her chest but I pressed a glass on it and it goes pale so I think thats ok? I've called her mum but cant get through. Not sure if I'm overreacting, sorry
